PathwayMech.description: Pathway-level microbial mechanisms with explicit participants, reactions, causal edges, and reference-backed evidence.
PathwayMech.notes: 152 pathway records and 152 published browser entries at the pin. Introduced separately from the September 28 ten-Mech census; vocabulary overlaps and PR statistics have not been measured for this introduction.

DUFMech.description: Domains and protein families of unknown function, with evidence gathering and triage worklists.
DUFMech.notes: Seed worklist of 6,532 Pfam families, with 4,533 unknown candidates and 1,999 historical DUFs. It is not a curated mechanism corpus and is excluded from curated-entry totals and the dated vocabulary census. No Pages browser or CLAW membership at this pin.
